# bintables/panic

> Helper: runtime errors. Prints a message to stderr and exits with status 2.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/panic.pkg)

Included with `@panic` by packages that can fail at run time. Each entry
point is jumped to (not called), since the program ends there:

| label | message |
|---|---|
| `__pk_panic_index` | `panic: index out of range` |
| `__pk_panic_len` | `panic: negative length in make` |
| `__pk_panic_oom` | `panic: out of memory` |

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm

```

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
__pk_panic_index:
lea rsi, [rel __pk_msg_index]
mov edx, __pk_msg_index_len
jmp __pk_panic
__pk_panic_len:
lea rsi, [rel __pk_msg_len]
mov edx, __pk_msg_len_len
jmp __pk_panic
__pk_panic_oom:
lea rsi, [rel __pk_msg_oom]
mov edx, __pk_msg_oom_len
__pk_panic:
mov eax, 1
mov edi, 2
syscall
mov eax, 60
mov edi, 2
syscall
section .data
__pk_msg_index: db "panic: index out of range", 10
__pk_msg_index_len equ $ - __pk_msg_index
__pk_msg_len: db "panic: negative length in make", 10
__pk_msg_len_len equ $ - __pk_msg_len
__pk_msg_oom: db "panic: out of memory", 10
__pk_msg_oom_len equ $ - __pk_msg_oom
section .text
```
